changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.comment: Add config JSONB column to notebook_page for template-seeded configuration

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.comment: Migrate known template-config keys from data column into the new config column. Keys migrated: manifestColumns, columns, qcSections, qcResultOptions, storageConditions, defaultRetentionYears, additionalFields. These keys are removed from data to complete the separation.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE clinlims.notebook_page SET config = COALESCE(config, '{}'::jsonb) || ( SELECT jsonb_object_agg(key, value) FROM jsonb_each(COALESCE(data, '{}'::jsonb)) WHERE key IN ( 'manifestColumns', 'columns', 'qcSections', 'qcResultOptions', 'storageConditions', 'defaultRetentionYears', 'additionalFields' ) ), data = ( SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(key, value), '{}'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_each(COALESCE(data, '{}'::jsonb)) WHERE key NOT IN ( 'manifestColumns', 'columns', 'qcSections', 'qcResultOptions', 'storageConditions', 'defaultRetentionYears', 'additionalFields' ) ) WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND data != '{}'::jsonb AND data ??| ARRAY[ 'manifestColumns', 'columns', 'qcSections', 'qcResultOptions', 'storageConditions', 'defaultRetentionYears', 'additionalFields' ];

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.comment: Document the purpose of the new config column
changeSet.sql: COMMENT ON COLUMN clinlims.notebook_page.config IS 'Read-only template configuration seeded by NotebookTemplateConfigurationHandler. Contains: manifestColumns, columns, qcSections, qcResultOptions, storageConditions, defaultRetentionYears, additionalFields. Never written by end-user API calls. Updated only on application start-up when JSON template files change.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN clinlims.notebook_page.data IS 'Runtime user data collected during workflow execution. Contains: qcResult, storageBox, storagePath, well assignments, timestamps, and any other data entered by lab staff. Written by POST /rest/notebook/page/{id}/data and bulk sample operations. Never contains template configuration keys.';
